human_summary: Seven people were killed when a bus ran into labourers waiting for work beside the Bogura-Naogaon regional highway near Erulia Bazar, Bogura Sadar, Bogura, around 5:30am yesterday [ev_3d9b6f7ef1b8f36b]. The Daily Star's account describes a speeding bus that ran over the workers, while a fire service official reported that the Naogaon-bound Shah Fateh Ali Paribahan bus, coming from Dhaka, had brake failure after giving way to a motorcycle, struck an electricity pole, and then hit labourers and people who had come to hire them [ev_7d10439deaca950c]. Ekattor TV independently reported seven deaths in a bus crash in Bogura and showed hospital treatment of injured persons, though no injury count was given [ev_deb71134d0e6a8a6, ev_be00c7adf6f585e6]. Locals blocked the road demanding speed breakers; an executive engineer promised installation [ev_3c2f6e349cdbbcef]. Authorities pledged compensation [ev_5a31009168ec3910], formed an inquiry committee [ev_35ec9cf7714b6c1c], and BRTA reported the bus lacked a route permit [ev_c8197f78704ba550]. Location precision is area-level, about 3 km around Erulia Bazar; an alternative district-level Bogura location is retained from the video source [ev_b02f78dc220fb6ca]. The main unresolved uncertainties are the total number of injured people and the conflicting reported causes of speeding versus brake failure.
